explanation: Binary-search between x and 1 in the order appropriate for x. Compare the midpoint square with x and stop when the interval endpoints are close under floating-point tolerance.
timeComplexity: O(log(W/ε)) interval-halving steps for initial width W and achieved tolerance ε
